title: introduce-geo-quarantine-kms-blacklist-and-audit-harden
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Introduce a conservative tenant-level "geo quarantine" mode and a KMS usage blacklist check to reduce blast radius when cross-region consent or KMS provenance anomalies are detected. The feature bundles three coordinated pieces: 1) a tenant quarantine state that can be set by policy or triggered automatically from anomaly detectors, which routes all inference requests into a restricted execution path; 2) a KMS blacklist validator that denies use of tenant-bound keys originating from disallowed regions or providers; and 3) hardened audit envelopes for quarantined operations to ensure immutable provenance and faster downstream forensic queries. Design summary: - TenantQuarantine: new RBAC-like flag attached to tenant records, surfaced to request handlers via request context and enforced by the routing layer. While quarantined requests are allowed read-only access to diagnostics endpoints, they cannot use write-affecting KMS operations or access dedicated capacity pools. - KMSBlacklistChecker: pluggable validator that inspects encryption context and key metadata; a denylist can be configured per-organization or via global policy. The checker integrates with the existing KMS abstraction and returns structured denial reasons for audit. - AuditHardening: quarantined requests are written into a separate append-only audit stream with additional signed metadata (operator id, trigger rule id, decision trace). This stream uses existing audit sink but tags entries for fast queries and retention overrides. Changes made: - service/routing/quarantine_middleware.go: new middleware to short-circuit handlers and inject quarantine metadata. - service/rbac/v2/policy_engine.go: policy evaluation hook to consider quarantine state for role decisions. - pkg/kms/blacklist_checker.go: core denylist logic and provider adapters. - service/audit/envelope_writer.go: envelope v2 writer with signature and extra fields for quarantined flows. - api/swagger.yaml: new admin endpoints POST /admin/tenants/{id}/quarantine and GET /admin/tenants/{id}/quarantine-status, and admin KMS denylist endpoints. - migrations/20241106_add_tenant_quarantine_flag.sql: schema migration adding tenant.quarantine_state, quarantine_reason, and quarantined_at. - tests/integration/quarantine_e2e_test.go and unit tests across modules. Rollout plan: - Feature gated behind feature flag security.quarantine_v1. - Deploy code to staging and run the anomaly -> auto-quarantine e2e. - Enable admin APIs for internal operators only, run shadow mode for KMS blacklist for 2 weeks (denylist logs only). - After monitoring, flip enforcement and progressively add protected tenants. Backwards compatibility and data migration: - Migration is additive; default quarantine_state = "none". Policies not referencing quarantine behave unchanged. - KMS blacklist defaults to empty; administrators must opt-in entries. Tests and validation: - Unit tests for policy engine, KMS adapters, and audit envelope signer. - Integration tests for middleware routing and admin APIs. - Load test to validate that quarantined stream tagging does not affect core write throughput (observed <2% p99 increase in staging). Security review notes: - Threat model updated to include denial amplification if attackers attempt mass-quarantine; mitigations include operator-only API permissions, rate limits, and audit alerting. - KMS provider adapters validate signed key metadata before decision. Follow-ups: - Add Linear ticket ENG-4302 to expose quarantine metrics in the Console and link to runbooks. - Post rollout: add canary rules for automated un-quarantine with step-down cooldown. Checklist: [x] migrations added [x] unit tests [x] integration tests [x] docs (admin) updated [x] security review done

release_notes: Added tenant-level quarantine and KMS denylist enforcement. Admins can quarantine tenants and configure KMS denylists via new admin APIs. Quarantine is feature-gated and initially disabled. Enables hardened auditing for quarantined flows.
notes: Observed <2% p99 write latency increase in staging when quarantine tagging enabled; recommended monitoring dashboards updated by ENG-ops.
